DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 砂場の道具をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like some sandpit tools?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと遊びたいのですが、スコップとバケツを忘れました。借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れた砂場道具の借用を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to play with my child, but I forgot our shovel and bucket. Can we borrow some?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow the sandpit tools you forgot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一組あります。こちらの黄色いバケツと青いスコップです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have one set: this yellow bucket and blue shovel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。水を入れて砂を固めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黄色バケツ青スコップを受け水利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. May we add water to make the sand firm?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the yellow bucket and blue shovel and ask about using water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少量なら使えます。水は砂場横の蛇口からくんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may use a small amount. Please get water from the tap beside the sandpit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: バケツに少しだけくみます。道具は遊んだ後、この受付へ返すのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量の取水と受付返却を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put just a little in the bucket. After playing, do we return the tools to this reception desk?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm taking a little water and returning the tools to reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。砂を落としてからお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please remove the sand before returning them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 遊び終わりました。バケツの底に砂が残っているので、もう少し払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遊び終了後の残砂を払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have finished playing. There is still sand at the bottom of the bucket, so I will brush off a little more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the remaining sand after playing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: きれいになりましたね。中のスコップもお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is clean now. Please take out the shovel inside too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黄色いバケツと青いスコップを返します。両方そろっていることも確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両用具がそろった返却を行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am returning the yellow bucket and blue shovel. I have checked that both are here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the tools, confirming both are present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお返しいただきました。ご来園ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27232-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received them back. Thank you for visiting the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えのご案内でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青線へ乗り換えます。案内図に連絡通路が二本ありますが、改札を出る方を通るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二本の連絡通路のうち改札内の経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am transferring to the Blue Line. The map shows two connecting passages. Should I use the one that goes outside the ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two connecting passages stays inside the ticket gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 青線へは改札内の通路です。出口へ下りる階段の手前を右へ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the Blue Line, use the passage inside the gates. Turn right before the stairs leading down to the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階段を下りずに右ですね。青線の両方向へ行ける通路ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を使わない経路と通路の分岐を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Right without going down the stairs, then. Does the passage lead to both directions of the Blue Line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the route without stairs and where the passage branches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路の先で方向が分かれます。どちらまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The directions split at the far end of the passage. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市民ホール前です。戻る方向のホームへ行かないよう、分かれ道の表示を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的駅を伝え方向表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Shimin Hall-mae. I would like to know what the sign at the junction says so I do not go to the platform in the opposite direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your destination station and ask about the direction signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 市民ホール前方面と書かれた左側です。途中の掲示板でも行先を確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Take the left side marked toward Shimin Hall-mae. You can also check the destination on the information boards along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左の表示を探します。手元の切符は、そのまま持って進めばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持っている切符の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look for the sign on the left. Should I just keep carrying this ticket as I go?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with the ticket you have. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この切符なら、連絡通路で改札を通す場面はありません。降車駅までお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: With this ticket, you will not need to put it through any gate in the connecting passage. Keep it until your destination station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符はしまわず持って、階段の手前から右へ進みます。教えていただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を持って案内された経路へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the ticket in my hand rather than putting it away, and turn right before the stairs. Thank you for explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the ticket and follow the route described. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。お気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what certificate you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 収入についての証明が必要です。この案内に二つの年が書かれていて、どちらを申請するのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年度と収入年の二つの表記で迷っていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need proof of income. There are two years written in these instructions, and I do not know which to apply for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help distinguishing the fiscal year and the year the income was earned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内を拝見します。「年度」と「収入のあった年」が別に書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the instructions. The “fiscal year” and the “year income was earned” are listed separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の仕事を始めたのは今年です。提出先が知りたいのは、昨年の収入のようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 就業開始年と提出先の求める収入年を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I started my current job this year. It seems the place requesting the certificate wants to know last year's income.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the year you started work and the income year requested by the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 仕事を始めた年だけで選ばず、提出先の指定を担当と確認しましょう。申請書は記入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than choosing only by the year you started work, let us check the recipient's requirements with the staff member in charge. Have you filled out the application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 種類の欄だけ書きました。年度は空けてあります。まだ間違った物を出したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請年度を未記入にしていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have filled in only the certificate type. I have left the fiscal year blank. I do not want to submit the wrong one at this point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have left the application's fiscal year blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それで結構です。この案内では指定が読み取りにくいので、提出先に問い合わせられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is fine. It is hard to interpret the requirement in these instructions. Can you contact the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当のメールアドレスがあります。年度の正式な名前を聞いてから、申請してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先へ正式な年度名を照会後申請したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the person's email address. May I apply after asking for the official fiscal-year designation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to apply after confirming the official fiscal-year designation with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。回答が来たら、案内と一緒に窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you receive a reply, bring it to the counter together with the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は用紙を持ち帰ります。どの年度か返事をもらってから、空欄を埋めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙を持ち帰り回答後に記入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the form home today. I will fill in the blank after getting a reply about which fiscal year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the form home and fill it out after the reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。また窓口でお声を掛けてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please speak to us again at the counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の薬の欄で、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the medication section of the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「服用中の薬」は、病院でもらった薬だけですか。自分で買った物も使っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診の服用中の薬に市販品も入るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does “medication currently taken” mean only medicine from a hospital? I also use some I bought myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether over-the-counter products belong in the questionnaire's current medication section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 市販の薬もお知らせください。どんな物か分かる袋や説明はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us about over-the-counter medicines too. Do you have packaging or instructions identifying them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 胃の薬の箱を持っています。昨日は飲みましたが、毎日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬の箱を示し使った日と頻度を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the box for a stomach medicine. I took it yesterday, but not every day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the medicine box and state when and how often you used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬の名前と、使った時期を伺います。飲み方が毎日でないことも書いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask the name and when you used it. You can also write that you do not take it every day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の名前を写して、昨日使ったと書きます。貼り薬もあるのですが、飲む薬ではないので別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品名と使用時期を記入し貼り薬の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will copy the name from the box and write that I took it yesterday. I also have a medicated patch. Is that separate because it is not taken orally?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the product name and when used, and ask how to report a medicated patch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使っている貼り薬も、お知らせください。この余白に書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us about the medicated patches you use too. You can write them in this space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 貼り薬は家に置いてきて、名前を覚えていません。「腰に使う貼り薬、名前不明」と書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な貼り薬名を推測せず記入してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I left the patches at home and do not remember the name. May I write “patch used on lower back, name unknown”?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can record the unknown patch name without guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように書き、あとで商品名が分かったら教えてください。診察でも使ったことをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write that, and let us know later when you find the product name. Also tell the doctor during the examination that you used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 市販の胃薬と名前不明の貼り薬を書きました。帰宅したら箱を見て、次に名前を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二種類の使用を記入し不明な商品名を後で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written the over-the-counter stomach medicine and the unnamed patch. I will look at the box at home and bring the name next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have recorded both medicines and will confirm the unknown product name later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診票と箱を確認しますので、お席でお待ちください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the questionnaire and box. Please wait in your seat. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不審な連絡についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a suspicious contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通販の返金をすると言われ、画面を共有するアプリを入れるよう頼まれました。入れる前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返金を理由とする画面共有アプリの導入要求を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone said they would refund my online purchase and asked me to install a screen-sharing app. I want advice before installing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about a request to install a screen-sharing app for a refund. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ入れていないのですね。どのような形で連絡が来ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not installed it yet, correct? How did they contact you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品を買った後、個人のメッセージで来ました。注文した店の名前は書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡手段と店舗名が不明な点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It came as a personal message after I bought the item. It does not name the store where I ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the contact method and that the store's name is not stated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: アプリの操作には進まず、届いた内容を見せてください。相手へ返信しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not proceed to operate the app. Please show us the message you received. Have you replied?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 注文番号だけ送りました。画面共有はしていません。ここにやり取りが残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送った情報と未実施の画面共有を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I sent only the order number. I have not shared my screen. The conversation is saved here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the information you sent from screen sharing that you have not done. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 残っている内容を確認します。返金の話は、購入した店の公式な窓口にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the saved messages. Please also verify the refund with the official contact of the store you bought from.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文画面から店へ問い合わせます。このメッセージにあるリンクは使わないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文画面の店舗窓口へ問い合わせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact the store through the order screen. I will avoid using the link in this message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to contact the store through the order screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのまま保存しておいてください。追加でアプリを入れるよう連絡が来ても、操作せずご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the messages as they are. If they contact you again asking you to install an app, do not operate it; consult us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。注文番号を送ったことも店に伝えます。こちらのやり取りは消さずに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店舗へ情報送信の事実を伝えメッセージを保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will also tell the store I sent my order number. I will keep this conversation without deleting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the store that you sent information and keep the messages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お話を伺いました。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have heard your account. Thank you for consulting us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱をお送りになりますか。中身を伺ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this box? May I ask what is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で作った粘土の置物です。まだ少し柔らかいのですが、今日送りたいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柔らかさの残る粘土作品を送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a clay ornament I made. It is still a little soft, but I was hoping to send it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send a clay piece that is still soft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この詰め方だと動いた時に形が変わりそうですね。作品を作った時の乾燥案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: With this packing, its shape may change if it moves. Do you have the drying instructions from when you made it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料の袋には二日乾かすとあります。作ったのは今朝なので、十分ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 製作時刻と材料の乾燥案内を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The material's bag says to dry it for two days. I made it this morning, so it has not been long enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you made it and the material's drying instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乾かしてから、動かないように包む方法を考えるとよさそうです。先方へ急ぎで届く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to let it dry, then consider wrapping it so it will not move. Does it need to reach the recipient urgently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 誕生日は来週です。今日は送らず、乾いてから持ってきます。箱だけ、この大きさで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送を延期し箱の大きさを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The birthday is next week. I will not send it today; I will bring it after it dries. As for the box, is this size large enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Postpone shipping and ask about the box size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周りへ緩衝材を入れる余裕が少ないですね。もう一回り大きい箱もご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is little room for cushioning around it. Would you like to see a box one size larger too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見せてください。葉の形の飾りが突き出ているので、そこへ重さがかからないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 突き出た飾りへの負担を避ける包装を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please show me. A leaf-shaped decoration sticks out, and I do not want any weight to press on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for packaging that avoids pressure on the protruding decoration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 底を支え、突き出た部分に物が当たらない詰め方を試してください。箱の見本はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Try supporting the bottom and packing it so nothing hits the protruding part. Here is a sample box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大きい箱に変えて、家で乾燥と梱包を済ませます。今日は作品を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を変え乾燥と梱包をしてから発送すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use a larger box and finish drying and packing at home. I will take the piece home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to change the box, dry and pack the piece, and then send it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。作品をお気をつけてお持ち帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care carrying your piece home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みですか。記入でお困りの所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you making a bank transfer? Is there anything on the form you need help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号は分かるのですが、普通か当座かが請求書にありません。このままでは書けませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求書に口座種類がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I know the account number, but the invoice does not say whether it is an ordinary deposit or current account. I cannot fill this in as it stands, can I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the invoice lacks the account type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の種類も必要です。請求元へ確認できる連絡先はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The account type is also needed. Do you have a contact to check with the invoice issuer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いつも連絡している事務所の番号があります。そこへ電話して聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既知の請求元窓口へ問い合わせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the number of the office I normally contact. I will call them and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the invoice issuer through a known office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの記入台でお待ちいただけます。確認できたらお声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can wait at this writing desk. Let us know once you have confirmed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 事務所では、請求書の印刷が抜けたと言われました。普通預金だそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 照会で判明した普通預金を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The office said it was omitted when the invoice was printed. They said it is an ordinary deposit account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that your inquiry confirmed an ordinary deposit account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、普通の欄へ印を付けてください。受取人名の記載にも指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then mark the ordinary-deposit box. Are there any instructions for writing the recipient's name too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社名の後の支店名も入れるよう言われました。番号だけでは足りなかったので、書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人名への支店名追記の指定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: They told me to include the branch name after the company name. The number alone was not enough, so I will add it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the instruction to add the branch name to the recipient's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご記入後、番号と金額を受付の画面でご覧いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After you fill it in, we will ask you to check the account number and amount on the counter screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 種類と支店名を書けました。画面でも照らし合わせて、この振込みを依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補完した依頼書で画面確認と振込みを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written the account type and branch name. I will also compare them on the screen and ask you to make this transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the completed form to request a screen check and the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 依頼書をお預かりします。お手続きの席へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the request form. Please go to the processing seat. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は千二百円です。お支払いはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your total is 1,200 yen. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ポイントで払いたいです。このカードの残りで足りるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポイント残高で代金を払えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to pay with points. Is the balance on this card enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your points balance can cover the purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残りは九百ポイントです。全部お使いになると、三百円が残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have 900 points left. If you use them all, 300 yen remains to pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九百ポイントを全部使います。残り三百円は現金で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全残高使用と不足分の現金払いを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use all 900 points. Can I pay the remaining 300 yen in cash?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to use the entire points balance and pay the shortfall in cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。先にポイントを使う処理をします。カードをこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We will process the points first. Please give me your card here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どうぞ。ポイントが三百円分残るのではなく、現金で三百円払うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残る支払額とポイント残高を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here you are. So it is not that 300 yen worth of points will remain; I pay 300 yen in cash, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the amount still payable from the points balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。ポイント残高はゼロになります。この表示でよろしければ決定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Your points balance will become zero. If this display is correct, I will confirm it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を見ました。九百ポイントを使ってください。現金は五百円を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 処理表示を確認し現金五百円を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the display. Please use 900 points. I will give you 500 yen in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the transaction display and hand over 500 yen cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 五百円お預かりしました。お釣りは二百円です。レシートへ二つの支払いが載ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have received 500 yen. Your change is 200 yen. Both payment methods will appear on the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お釣りを受け取りました。レシートでポイントと現金を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 釣り銭を受け取り二つの支払方法を記録すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the change. I will record the points and cash separately using the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive your change and say you will record the two payment methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お買物をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇へ行かれますか。今、中央の通路で散水をしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you going to the flowerbeds? We are watering the central path at the moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そうなのですね。花を見ながら十分くらい歩きたいのですが、ぬれない道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散水を避けた十分程度の散歩経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I see. I would like to walk for about ten minutes looking at the flowers. Is there a route where I will not get wet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a roughly ten-minute walking route avoiding the watering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物側の通路は散水していません。遠回りになりますが、花壇の裏へ出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We are not watering the path along the building. It is a detour, but it leads behind the flowerbeds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そちらを歩きます。花壇の裏にも、座れる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迂回経路を選び休める場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will walk that way. Is there somewhere to sit behind the flowerbeds too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the detour and ask where you can rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 木の下にベンチがあります。水は掛かりませんが、朝の雨で座面がぬれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a bench under the tree. The watering does not reach it, but the seat is wet from this morning's rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は座らず、そこで少し立って休みます。中央の通路は、帰る頃には通れそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ぬれたベンチを避け散水の終了時刻を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not sit today, just stand there and rest a little. Will the central path be passable by the time I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid the wet bench and ask when the watering will finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あと二十分ほど散水する予定です。十分の散歩なら、まだ続いていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We plan to water for about another twenty minutes. If you walk for ten minutes, I think it will still be continuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りも建物側を通ります。入口の売店が見えたら、この道へ戻ればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 散歩後も迂回し入口の目印を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take the building-side path back too. Once I see the shop at the entrance, I should return to this path, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the detour on the return and confirm the landmark at the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。売店の前へ戻れます。花壇の裏から分かれる砂利道へは入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You can return in front of the shop. Do not take the gravel path that branches off behind the flowerbeds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 砂利道には入らず、建物側を往復します。水の時間を先に聞けて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 砂利道を避け建物側を往復すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will avoid the gravel path and go both ways along the building. It helped to ask about the watering time first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to avoid the gravel path and go out and back along the building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。お散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の遅れについてのご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about the train delay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十時半に人と会う予定です。この列車は、到着も十五分遅れると思えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出発遅延が到着時刻にもそのまま当てはまるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am meeting someone at 10:30. Should I assume this train will also arrive fifteen minutes late?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the departure delay applies unchanged to the arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の表示は出発の遅れです。途中の状況で、到着の遅れが変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current display is the departure delay. The arrival delay may change depending on conditions along the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 到着時刻が確定したわけではないのですね。別の列車に乗る方が早くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確定の到着を理解し別列車との比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the arrival time is not confirmed. Would taking another train be faster?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the unconfirmed arrival time and ask to compare another train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 隣のホームの各駅停車は出発しますが、目的地によっては後から着きます。どちらまでですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The local train on the next platform will depart, but depending on your destination it may arrive later. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 美術館前です。乗り換えを増やすより、この列車を待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地を伝え直通列車を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bijutsukan-mae. I would rather wait for this train than add more transfers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your destination and decide to wait for the direct train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この列車は美術館前へ直通です。出発が決まったら放送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This train goes directly to Bijutsukan-mae. We will announce when its departure is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には、直通を待っていて到着が遅れると連絡します。放送はこの待合席でも聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手への連絡内容を伝え待合席の放送を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell the person that I am waiting for the direct train and will arrive late. Can I hear the announcement from these waiting seats too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say what you will tell the person and check whether announcements are audible at the waiting seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 聞こえます。画面にも出発の案内が表示されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Departure information will also appear on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで画面を見ながら待ちます。新しい時刻が出たら、相手へもう一度知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を見て新情報を相手へ知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here watching the screen. When a new time appears, I will tell the person again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will watch the screen and pass on the new information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お待たせして申し訳ありません。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We apologize for keeping you waiting. Goodbye.
